verdict.rationale: Sift documents Review Queues and a Decisions API for sending business decisions back to Sift. Nothing in the evidence shows an API or agent interface for pulling flagged queue cases with their context, summarizing evidence, or producing recommended decisions for human confirmation. The Score, Decisions and Workflows APIs are developer building blocks from which such an agent could be built, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can work the review queue — pull flagged cases with their context, summarize the evidence, and recommend a decision for a human to confirm
